HFT visibility is governed by the authoring policy above.","docket_mode":"quarantine_without_hft","docket_ready":true}},"selected_context_units":[],"support_registry":[{"branch_refs":[],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:retrospective_surprises_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_21cc38b2e383ca94c798","text":"The punitive \"home\" in 32:20 made مأوى morally neutral as a gathering destination until its contents are named; gardens and prepared hospitality distinguish this مأوى. The agricultural sign in 32:27 later gave the covered garden a visible causal prehistory in water, earth, and growth.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000070/B001","root_000876/B001"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-3","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_2e37a35d505404b49616","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"32:19:5\",\"root_000876\",[\"B001\"]],[\"32:19:8\",\"root_000070\",[\"B001\"]]],\"grade\":\"weak\",\"text\":\"Barınağın yarayı kapatır gibi bir araya getirme çağrışımı, iyi işlerin sağlamlığıyla birleşerek son durağa onarıcı bir sığınma boyutu ekler.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_001492/B002","root_001492/B005"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-2","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_334a822e9fbe2e412565","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"32:19:9\",\"root_001492\",[\"B002\",\"B005\"]]],\"grade\":\"weak\",\"text\":\"Kitabın inişiyle aynı kökten gelen konuk azığı, önceki vahyi bu son ağırlamaya götüren işleri mümkün kılan ön hazırlık olarak gösterir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000054/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_33fbaec71a9edeb552ef","text":"3. **A sustained practice, not a bare group-name, produces the congruent habitat.** `ء م ن:B002` supplies trusting assent and `ص ل ح:B001` sound or right action. The opening relative clause specifies both, while the closing *bimā kānū yaʿmalūn* repeats work as the causal explanation. **Packet relation:** faith + sound deeds -> sheltering gardens, because of their ongoing work. **Inferred arrow:** repeated sound action shapes an orientation that the final sound habitat answers. The double mention of work prevents identity alone from carrying the mechanism.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000070/B001","root_000266/B001","root_000266/B003","root_001492/B005"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-1","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_372943a9f5c0823c941f","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"32:19:7\",\"root_000266\",[\"B001\",\"B003\"]],[\"32:19:8\",\"root_000070\",[\"B001\"]],[\"32:19:9\",\"root_001492\",[\"B005\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Bahçe, barınak ve konuk azığı anlamları üst üste gelerek varış yerini örten, toplayan ve geleni hazırlanmış nimetle karşılayan katmanlı bir ağırlama yapar.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":[],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_5e9d0de7378c334d6699","text":"2. **The opening descent becomes hospitality at the end.** The same **ن ز ل** root that marked the Book's descent in 32:2 now appears as **B005**, guest-provision, while **ع م ل B001** is repeated around the causal بِمَا. I infer that the earlier descending Book was itself advance provision enabling the works for which final provision is prepared. Revelation and reward become two stages of one host-guest relation.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":[],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:retrospective_surprises_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_667698c59db5bb146894","text":"Later 32:20 reused *maʾwā* for fire and thereby made the garden's covering function newly salient: the same gathering relation can shelter or imprison depending on its content. 32:24 added that patient certainty also generates guidance for others, expanding the “work” behind hospitality beyond private conduct.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000266/B003"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_6913e5514ac3a557e388","text":"1. **Layered hospitality: covering, refuge, and guest-provision.** **ج ن ن B003** supplies tree-covered gardens, **ء و ي B001** a sheltering gathering point, and **ن ز ل B005** prepared provision for a guest or lodger. These nouns accumulate rather than merely repeat \"paradise.\" I infer a nested hospitality mechanism: covering receives them, refuge gathers them, and provision sustains them. Their destination reads as actively prepared reception, not only scenic reward.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000070/B001","root_000266/B003"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_a65d1b9d4dd2f8cf0b2a","text":"1. **Their destination gathers and protects rather than merely containing.** `ج ن ن:B003` gives a tree-covered garden, retaining the basal covering image of `ج ن ن:B001`; `ء و ي:B001` gives movement into a sheltering or gathering point. The possessive *fa-lahum* follows faith and sound action. **Inferred arrow:** trusting action -> allocation of a covered, living gathering place -> settled belonging. *Jannātu al-maʾwā* makes destination an active shelter relation, not just coordinates in space.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001492/B005"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_ade93747bbf8c1aeffbc","text":"2. **The shelter is also staged as reception.** `ن ز ل:B005` specifically supplies guest-provision and lodging for *nuzulan*. Its accusative placement after the garden-shelter recasts what “belongs to them” as something prepared to meet arrival. **Inferred arrow:** return to the destination -> reception with provision -> the endpoint experienced as welcome. This hospitality reading coexists with recompense because *bimā kānū yaʿmalūn* immediately states the causal basis.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000070/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_b7d1f0d7a4554fa5c992","text":"3. **Shelter as drawing-together and repair.** The scope of **ء و ي B001** includes a wound drawing together toward healing, while **ص ل ح B001** supplies soundness against corruption. The workers of sound deeds are assigned مأوى. I infer that their refuge gathers what worldly exertion left exposed and brings it to settled soundness. The abode reads as reparative shelter as well as residence.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000054/B002","root_000876/B001","root_001046/B001"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-4","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_e2e59efece2617a03e93","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"32:19:3\",\"root_000054\",[\"B002\"]],[\"32:19:4\",\"root_001046\",[\"B001\"]],[\"32:19:5\",\"root_000876\",[\"B001\"]],[\"32:19:12\",\"root_001046\",[\"B001\"]]],\"grade\":\"weak\",\"text\":\"Sürekli iyi davranış, sonradan kendisine uygun sağlam ve koruyucu bir yaşama alanıyla karşılık bulur; belirleyici olan yalnız grup adı değil, sürdürülen iştir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"anchor_evidence":[],"anchor_evidence_coverage":{"boundary":"Exact Arabic verifies surface contact only.
